# reuters.com

reuters.com
Special delivery: Italy's postman joins the AI infrastructure race
Valentina Za, Elvira Pollina
6-8 分鐘
Summary
Companies
Poste seeking to acquire telecoms operator TIM with €13.5 billion bid
Enlarged group could be vehicle to boost tech backbone
Telcos struggle to fund advanced 5G networks in tough Italian market
MILAN, July 10 (Reuters) - Italy has picked an unlikely champion to develop its technology infrastructure and protect digital sovereignty: its national postman.

Poste Italiane
(PST.MI), opens new tab
, the postal service which pays out pensions through 12,600 post offices that are as much a feature of ​remote towns as the local church, is betting on its €13.5 billion ($15.4 billion) bid for Telecom Italia (TIM)
(TLIT.MI), opens new tab
to accelerate its shift into digital, telecom and cloud services.The Reuters Inside Track newsletter is your essential guide during the World Cup.Sign up here.

Two-thirds owned by the state, Poste ‌started its digital transformation in the early 2000s, venturing into electronic payments.Over the past decade it has signed up 30 million users - around 70% of the total - to Italy's digital ID system to access public services online.Serving 46 million customers across banking, insurance, telecommunications and energy, Poste also uses its branches, Italy's biggest retail network, to give access to public services such as passport applications to the less digitally savvy.

The proposed deal with TIM fits into a broader sovereign cloud push in Europe, with ​domestic telecom and tech firms in Germany and France building cloud and AI infrastructure to serve strategic sectors such as defence and healthcare as well as other parts of the public administration.BUILDING UP ​TECH CAPACITY
Poste argues the tie-up will create a larger state-backed group that can build distributed computing infrastructure across the country, a person briefed on the plans for ⁠TIM said.

Even without the investment firepower and the scale of U.S.tech giants such as Amazon, Google or Microsoft, Poste says the new entity could become a supplier for these companies, the person added.Big tech companies ​buy infrastructure services ranging from fibre networks to data-centre capacity from telecom operators, as well as local network access points close to end users.With 125 megawatts of installed data centre capacity, TIM is a top three national operator.

​However, Italy has only around 15% of Germany's installed capacity.Alongside TIM's existing data centres, Poste-TIM could boost computing capacity at broadly distributed telecom hubs and convert former postal sorting centres into local edge-computing hubs, bringing processing power closer to users, Poste argued, according to the person.In the future, TIM's mobile network sites could also come into play, the person added.Poste and TIM both declined to comment.

"As demand for data centres grows, the industry is increasingly looking at networks of smaller facilities located closer to users rather ​than just large, centralised sites," said Antonio Capone, dean of the School of Industrial and Information Engineering at Milan's Politecnico University.With assets spread across the country, telecom operators are well placed to develop such facilities, Capone ​added."This is an emerging trend in the industry, and Poste is right to focus on it.

Managing a distributed network is operationally more complex — think of maintenance, cooling or power management — but it is a challenge that makes strategic sense ‌to embrace," he ⁠said.Europe lags behind the United States in AI investment and infrastructure and Italy is further hobbled by much higher energy costs than France or Spain.

Poste share price move since launching TIM's bid
TIM'S TOUGH JOURNEY
An ill-fated privatisation three decades ago saddled TIM with debt and it has since faced cut‑throat price competition that hammered profits and curtailed its ability to spend to upgrade its infrastructure.Despite halving its debt to core profit ratio and almost doubling its revenue per employee with the 2024 sale of its fixed line network to U.S.fund KKR
(KKR.N), opens new tab
, TIM would struggle to sustain prospective 5G and cloud investments.

Italy has made progress on basic 5G technology, but AI-powered services require advanced 5G networks.In the U.S.these account ​for a fifth of total mobile connections but ​Spain is the only European country where the figure ⁠is above 5%."Building a 5G network is extremely capital intensive and you need scale to make it viable: you cannot sustain four mobile network operators in a market like Italy," a leading TIM investor said, adding the investment case hinged on expected industry consolidation.

TIM competes with Vodafone-Fastweb, WindTre and Iliad.WindTre, owned by Hong Kong ​conglomerate CK Hutchison
(0001.HK), opens new tab
, and France's Iliad started exploring a tie-up, Reuters reported last year but no deal has so far materialised.Poste already owns 20% of TIM.​A full takeover will allow ⁠Italy to reap the benefits of higher profits at the former phone monopoly were the number of operators to fall to three through long-mooted consolidation.

Requesting anonymity and declining to say whether they would take up the offer, the investor noted that a rise in Poste's share price since the announcement suggested the market thought benefits from the deal may exceed the targeted €700 million.

As a state‑backed operator the new entity could handle sensitive communications, including in defence, the investor added, ⁠pointing also ​to Poste's "low‑leverage business with strong cash generation from payments, insurance and financial services."
Poste has said the tie-up would support TIM's efforts to ​expand beyond its traditional consumer telecom business, which has been shrinking for more than a decade, into higher margin services for corporate clients, including cloud and cybersecurity.

"From a commercial standpoint the combination has a strong rationale: an even wider bundle of services could be offered to ​an even larger client base.That increases switching costs and helps customer retention," consultancy AlixPartners partner Claudio Baretti said.($1 = 0.8763 euros)
Reporting by Valentina Za and Elvira Pollina Editing by Keith Weir
Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles., opens new tab

# reuters.com

reuters.com
特別投遞：義大利郵差加入 AI 基礎建設競賽
Valentina Za、Elvira Pollina
6-8 分鐘
摘要
公司
義大利郵政擬以 135 億歐元出價收購電信業者 TIM
擴大後的集團可能成為強化科技骨幹的載具
在嚴峻的義大利市場，電信業者難以籌資建設先進 5G 網路
米蘭，7 月 10 日（路透）— 義大利選了一個不太可能的人選，來發展其科技基礎建設並保護數位主權：國家的郵差。

Poste Italiane
(PST.MI)，開啟新分頁
，這家郵政服務公司透過 12,600 間郵局發放退休金；在偏遠城鎮裡，郵局就像當地教堂一樣是常見地標。它正押注以 135 億歐元（154 億美元）出價收購 Telecom Italia（TIM）
(TLIT.MI)，開啟新分頁
，以加速轉型至數位、電信與雲端服務。Reuters Inside Track 電子報是你在世界盃期間不可或缺的指南。請在此註冊。

Poste 有三分之二股權由國家持有，並在 2000 年代初期開始數位轉型，投入電子支付。過去十年來，它已讓 3,000 萬名使用者註冊義大利用於線上取得公共服務的數位身分系統，約占總數的 70%。Poste 在銀行、保險、電信與能源領域服務 4,600 萬名客戶，也運用其分行網絡，也就是義大利最大的零售網絡，協助數位能力較不足的人取得護照申請等公共服務。

這項與 TIM 的擬議交易，符合歐洲更廣泛推動主權雲的趨勢；德國與法國的本土電信與科技公司，正在建置雲端與 AI 基礎建設，服務國防、醫療等戰略部門，以及公共行政的其他領域。建構科技能量
一名了解 TIM 相關計畫的人士表示，Poste 主張，這項整併將打造出一個更大的國家支持集團，能在全國建置分散式運算基礎設施。

即使沒有 Amazon、Google 或 Microsoft 等美國科技巨頭的投資火力與規模，Poste 仍認為，這個新實體可能成為這些公司的供應商，該人士補充說。大型科技公司會向電信業者採購各種基礎設施服務，從光纖網路到資料中心容量，也包括靠近終端使用者的在地網路接入點。TIM 擁有 125 兆瓦的已建置資料中心容量，是全國前三大業者之一。

不過，義大利的已建置容量僅約為德國的 15%。據該人士說，Poste 主張，除了 TIM 既有的資料中心外，Poste-TIM 還可以在分布廣泛的電信樞紐提升運算容量，並將過去的郵件分揀中心轉換為在地邊緣運算樞紐，把處理能力帶到更靠近使用者的地方。該人士補充說，未來 TIM 的行動網路基地台也可能派上用場。Poste 和 TIM 均拒絕置評。

「隨著資料中心需求成長，業界越來越重視位於使用者附近、由較小型設施組成的網路，而不只是大型、集中式的據點，」米蘭理工大學工業與資訊工程學院院長 Antonio Capone 表示。Capone 補充說，電信業者的資產遍布全國，很適合發展這類設施。「這是業界正在興起的趨勢，Poste 聚焦於此是正確的。

管理分散式網路在營運上更複雜，想想維護、冷卻或電力管理就知道，但這是一項在策略上值得承擔的挑戰，」他說。歐洲在 AI 投資與基礎設施方面落後美國，而義大利又受到能源成本遠高於法國或西班牙的進一步限制。

Poste 自提出收購 TIM 以來的股價走勢
TIM 的艱難歷程
三十年前一場命運多舛的民營化讓 TIM 背上債務，此後又面臨激烈的價格競爭，重創獲利並限制其投入基礎設施升級的能力。儘管 TIM 在 2024 年將固定線路網路出售給美國基金 KKR
(KKR.N)，開啟新分頁
後，已將債務與核心獲利比率減半，並讓每名員工營收幾乎翻倍，但 TIM 仍難以支撐未來可能需要的 5G 與雲端投資。

義大利在基礎 5G 技術上已有進展，但 AI 驅動服務需要進階 5G 網路。在美國，這類連線占整體行動連線的五分之一，但西班牙是唯一比例高於 5% 的歐洲國家。「建置 5G 網路極度資本密集，而且需要規模才能讓它可行：像義大利這樣的市場，無法支撐四家行動網路營運商，」一位 TIM 主要投資人表示，並補充說，投資理由取決於預期中的產業整併。

TIM 的競爭對手包括 Vodafone-Fastweb、WindTre 和 Iliad。WindTre 由香港企業集團長江和記實業（CK Hutchison）
（0001.HK），開啟新分頁
持有；路透社去年報導，WindTre 與法國 Iliad 已開始探索合併可能，但至今尚未達成任何交易。Poste 已持有 TIM 20% 股權。若全面收購，一旦透過醞釀已久的整併使營運商數量降至三家，義大利將能享有這家前電話壟斷企業獲利提高所帶來的好處。

這名投資人要求匿名，並拒絕透露是否會接受收購提議。他指出，自消息公布以來 Poste 股價上漲，顯示市場認為這筆交易帶來的效益可能超過目標中的 7 億歐元。

這名投資人補充說，作為有國家支持的營運商，新實體可以處理包括國防在內的敏感通訊；他也指出 Poste 是「低槓桿企業，並由支付、保險和金融服務帶來強勁現金流」。
Poste 表示，這項合併將支持 TIM 努力從萎縮超過十年的傳統消費者電信業務，拓展到面向企業客戶、利潤率更高的服務，包括雲端與資安。

「從商業角度來看，兩者結合有很強的合理性：可以向更大的客戶群提供更廣泛的服務組合。這會提高轉換成本，並有助於留住客戶，」顧問公司 AlixPartners 合夥人 Claudio Baretti 說。（1 美元 = 0.8763 歐元）
Valentina Za 與 Elvira Pollina 報導；Keith Weir 編輯
我們的標準：湯森路透信任原則。，開啟新分頁

這名投資人要求匿名，並拒絕透露是否會接受收購提議。他指出，自消息公布以來 Poste 股價上漲，顯示市場認為這筆交易帶來的效益可能超過目標中的 7 億歐元。

這名投資人補充說，作為有國家支持的營運商，新實體可以處理包括國防在內的敏感通訊；他也指出 Poste 是「低槓桿企業，並由支付、保險和金融服務帶來強勁現金流」。
Poste 表示，這項合併將支持 TIM 努力從萎縮超過十年的傳統消費者電信業務，拓展到面向企業客戶、利潤率更高的服務，包括雲端與資安。

「從商業角度來看，兩者結合有很強的合理性：可以向更大的客戶群提供更廣泛的服務組合。這會提高轉換成本，並有助於留住客戶，」顧問公司 AlixPartners 合夥人 Claudio Baretti 說。（1 美元 = 0.8763 歐元）
